title: デビュー戦の後に・出立、悠々と

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for your support, everyone! Thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Did you see, Trainer? My very first race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's wonderful to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is the first step toward achieving my goal. I'm glad I managed to make an impressive start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. I was just… absorbed in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking of how, having been successful in my debut, I've gained the opportunity to strive for my goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho is a race treasured in the memories of both my grandmother and grandfather, the pillars of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Therefore, my desire is to win the Tenno Sho, no matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My abilities as a stayer have been valued highly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to set a goal of conquering the spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To honor the Mejiro family and its members, who have showered me with love all my life.
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That said, I'm merely at the starting point right now. The Tenno Sho is still a ways in the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have plenty of time, so I must carefully hone my abilities.
choice_data_list: We can start by gaining some experience in the junior- and classic-year races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, so that I can claim victory in the spring Tenno Sho without fail!
